Long, flowing charcoal-black hair with straight-cut bangs and a silky texture. Narrow, haunting crimson-red eyes with a melancholic expression. Apparent age in the early twenties with a mature, poised demeanor. Slender, graceful build. A dark, gothic-inspired kimono in shades of obsidian and deep violet with ornate gold embroidery. Pale skin paired with long, black fingernails and a floating, dark spectral rigging.
BODY COLOR: pale ivory
